purpose: Clarify comparable denominators and exact jointly supported claim counting; preserve original calls and individual judgments.
rules: For each primary case collect reference decisions from both groups of both judges. Use the same all-four-admit reference case set for cross-setting false-rejection rates; separately report uncertain reference cases and flags outside that set.
A jointly supported claim requires both readers to support the same exact claim index. Minimum of per-reader supported counts is not an intersection.
Report within-judge reference disagreements across the two groups as well as disagreements between readers.
Median latency averages the two central observations for even sample sizes. State the percentile convention.
selection_priority_unchanged: Source quality and useful coverage precede cost; no historical truth is inferred from model agreement.
